snippet.title: Schrodinger's Call - Official Developer Deep Dive Trailer | Women-Led Games x SGF 2026
snippet.description: Watch the Developer Deep Dive for Schrodinger's Call, a visual text-based novel developed by Acrobatic Chirimenjako. Players will accompany souls wandering between life and death to choose the last words to say to them as the world comes to an end. Schrodinger's Call is available now for PC (Steam).
